entries.09cff6ee1d763cfc: This is a reportable segment that provides management support aimed at improving the productivity of small and medium-sized enterprises by promoting DX and AI in business operations. The company combines IT tool introduction support, human resource development support, marketing support and funding support such as subsidies and grants, and AKARI Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, also helps sell the company's services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,233 million.

entries.53fc89f6b3584824: This is a system that automatically diagnoses subsidies and grants that a company can use, and allows applications for them to be requested online directly. Regional financial institutions, large and mid-sized enterprises and local governments that have many small and micro enterprises as customers adopt it and use it to support their own customers and acquire new customers. After the application request is made, it is handed over to J-Consul. The amount is not separately disclosed.

entries.70bccda93d0ad80f: A category not included in the reportable segments, which includes the content business. In response to customers' marketing issues, it plans and provides Web marketing support measures such as email marketing support, social media activation support and content production, and its main customers are large and mid-sized companies. Besides direct transactions, it also conducts indirect transactions through advertising agencies. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥295 million.

entries.9cfb1abc792a026a: This is a management consulting service that supports resolution of management issues through DX and AI in business operations, and securing the funds needed to advance DX and AI, from the perspectives of IT, human resources, marketing and subsidies and grants. Its feature is that it works with professionals qualified in each specialized field and also provides guidance on using public support schemes offered by the government and local governments. entries.aa474baa638e5255: This is a joint network in which small and medium-sized enterprises across Japan participate. Participating companies can leverage their scale to purchase IT, human resources, marketing and other products and services at low prices, and secure revenue by selling them to their own customers. The amount is not separately disclosed.
